true_option: No — NIST guidelines prohibit password hints and knowledge-based security questions

true_claim_text: NIST SP 800-63B prohibits storing password hints and using knowledge-based authentication prompts

source: NIST SP 800-63B: verifiers SHALL NOT permit the subscriber to store a hint accessible to an unauthenticated claimant and SHALL NOT prompt subscribers to use specific types of information (e.g., knowledge-based questions) when choosing memorized secrets.
